values.note: Peak season (2026-05-08 to 2026-09-23): standard non-electric $24, standard electric $34, and two further non-electric rate templates at $30 and $38. Off-peak: non-electric $18, electric $20 (the $38 template is $34). Same tables 2025-2028.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233627/rates (2026 Peak Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $24, STANDARD ELECTRIC $34, STANDARD NONELECTRIC-121569 $30, STANDARD NONELECTRIC-121510 $38; Non-Peak $18/$20/$20/$34), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog for 233627 (14 bookable STANDARD ELECTRIC sites list 50-amp, 67 more and the 23 RV ELECTRIC sites 30-amp; RV ELECTRIC sites list Water Hookup 'No', no sewer anywhere), read 2026-10-20

values.note: recreation.gov describes 'over 300 campsites' and lists 318 bookable ones (214 standard non-electric, 81 standard electric, 23 RV electric), all back-in apart from one. Listed lengths run mostly 45-60 ft, but the campground warns that 'the maximum vehicle length indicated on the site description is actually the total length of the site', so they are not rig limits.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233627 ('This large campground contains over 300 campsites'; notice on vehicle length) + recreation.gov catalog for 233627, read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233627 ('Flush toilets, drinking water, showers and a dump station are provided'; notice 'A sewage dump station and freshwater fill station are available on site'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Golden Loop (#1-26) and Old Duck Loop (#192-225) stay open until November 30 (2026 notice).

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233627 (notice: 'Golden Loop (#1-26) and Old Duck Loop (#192-225) are open until Nov. 30, 2026'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 'The campground is reservation only. Reservations can be made on the day of arrival.' Two camping units per site: one wheeled unit and one tent, or two tents.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233627 (Facilities: 'The campground is reservation only. Reservations can be be made on the day of arrival'; notices), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed 50-amp electric (14 sites; no water/sewer), $18 base, reservable on rec.gov. Changed sites 200 -> 318 (rec.gov: over 300, 318 bookable) and fees high 34 -> 38 (a $38 peak non-electric template). Added showers/flush toilets/water/dump, reservation-only (no walk-up), a late-season loop note. Not set: max_rig_ft (rec.gov says its lengths are total site lengths), campground season, window. rec.gov's 'Waterfront Sites' amenity agrees with the lakefront call.
